title: Review campaign evidence and adapt the next email without reusing its send approval

source.ref: Owner request 2026-11-13: implement the personal-list campaign audit and connect analysis to the existing email flows.

detail: Local implementation adds a bounded recipient-deduplicated learning reader, privacy-safe promise/destination audit and an explicit reviewed revision in the existing CRM Marketing workspace. The baseline lacked these modules; new behavioral tests failed before implementation. Applying a recomputed proposal uses a guarded atomic draft write, rejects prior send history and evergreen quiet-member targets, preserves the selected audience and purpose, and invalidates approval, schedule, test proof and compiled HTML. Existing model coaching remains read-only. A live read verified audience makeup and recorded provider counts while isolating a malformed bounce. The owner-authorized November 17 campaign correction was separately applied and read back: participant browse copy, public events CTA, Daniel sender, conversation replies, all_contacts, draft/unapproved/unscheduled, no recipient sends. The reusable UI and actions still require code review and deployment; GitHub access is now available; row ID was reassigned because LIVE-2274 belongs to another open PR. No migration or email send was performed.
